thread:
maria: Hey — trying to pull traces + the service overview for model-serving-gamma in ap-southeast-2. Can someone drop the dashboard shortlink? Also I'm getting a 500 spike in prod traces but I can't view traces here :/
omar: I put the grafana panels in the team watchlist: https://grafana.redwood.co/d/UX8a1/service-overview?var-service=model-serving-gamma&var-region=ap-southeast-2 :eyes:
jin: For traces we use Tempo, here's a direct trace search with the service filter: https://tempo.redwood.co/trace-search?service=model-serving-gamma&org=redwood&region=ap-southeast-2. If you still can't open either link it's a perms issue (observability-viewer role).
maria: Thanks — I click and get a 403 on both. How do I request the role?
omar: Two options: 1) Quick way: ping infra-access in #help and include the grafana/tempo links + your org path. 2) Longer (preferred for audit): Go to https://console.redwood.co/permissions -> Request Access -> choose "observability-viewer" -> select org: "redwood/ap-southeast-2" and add justification. Typically approved within 2 business hours.
lina: Also fyi the 500 spike correlates with a recent rollout (canary) from yesterday. If you need immediate visibility, share the trace ids and I can paste screenshots.
maria: Rollout id was canary-2026-03-16-17:12, I have a few trace ids: 1f4d2c, 1f4d3a, 1f4d9b. Can someone confirm if those are full-stack traces (frontend -> gateway -> model-serving) or just model-server spans?
jin: Those look like full traces. Quick lookup in Tempo showed gateway -> inference-proxy -> model-server spans. Here's a quick curl you can run locally if you have api-key with observability read perms:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OBS_KEY" \
  "https://tempo.redwood.co/api/traces/1f4d2c" | jq '.'
```
maria: I don't have the key yet. Can someone run and paste top-level span names?
olerts-bot: [alert] ModelHighErrorRate (model-serving-gamma, ap-southeast-2) triggered 2026-03-16T17:18:22Z — error_rate=8.3% :rotating_light:
omar: I pulled 1f4d2c: top spans are gateway.request -> inference-proxy.call_model -> model-server.generate. Error seems to originate inside model-server.generate (stack: OOM in python worker).
lina: Given the spike and OOM hints, we should: 1) Add a temporary alert mute for the canary namespace for 30m if we expect noisy churn. 2) Tune ModelHighErrorRate alert to include min_request_volume: 50 and threshold: 5% for ap-southeast-2. I can open a PR for the alert-rule change if folks agree.
maria: Ok please open PR and also paste the grafana shortlink here once perms are sorted so I can bookmark. :thumbsup:
omar: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alerts/pull/842 — includes the min_request_volume param and region scoping. Also added the dashboard shortlink to the description.
jin: If you need temp access to view traces now and it's urgent, I can create a time-limited read token for you (1 hour). Maria — want me to do that?
maria: Yes please, that would help. Thanks everyone! :heart:
omar: Leaving the grafana link again for bookmarks: https://grafana.redwood.co/d/UX8a1/service-overview?var-service=model-serving-gamma&var-region=ap-southeast-2
lina: Adding postmortem note: if OOM continues, next steps are - increase model-server heap, roll back canary, or revert the quant-byte change from yesterday.
maria: Got it. Will follow up once I have access or the token. Thanks all.
